body: Lia, useful ang shame angle, pero ingat din tayo na gawing psychological explanation ang lahat. May simpler rule dito: kapag ang 'recovery' ng pera ay nangangailangan munang magpadala ka ulit ng pera, burden of proof should become brutally high. Compassion sa victim does not require endless ambiguity about the offer. Minsan ang mature acceptance ay hindi dramatic healing; boring lang siya: stop payment, preserve evidence, verify independently, at tanggapin na walang magic undo button.
